instruction: Help me troubleshoot and fix the 'npm: command not found' error that appears when I try 'npm --version'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.verification: Evaluator uses existing get_vm_command_line getter to execute 'npm --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 1 || echo 0'. If npm is installed and working, command exits with 0 and echo 1 is executed. Otherwise echo 0 is executed. Uses existing exact_match metric to compare against expected '1\n'.
